findings.excerpt: - The decoding is defined for every labeling of $G_t$, canonical lifts included: for the canonical lift $\bar\sigma$ of a base labeling $\sigma$, every pattern from $v$ ends at a vertex $w$ whose view claims $\sigma(v)$ for $v$, so $p_v$ is concentrated on $\sigma(v)$ and $\hat{\bar\sigma}=\sigma$.
